inspiration.title: Lightbot
inspiration.note: The core idea of giving a robot a short list of instructions to clear a room, kept timer-free with medals for fewer steps and a free sandbox once you finish.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
